items.title: Casa Magna, New Times, New Image
items.summary: By pressing the 'I AM OF LEGAL AGE' button, I agree that I am of legal age for smoking and drinking in my country. Quesada Cigars is undergoing a period of transition and transformation under the leadership of Raquel and Patricia Quesada—a shift that inevitably brings a new style better suited to the times. At Intertabac 2026, Raquel Quesada focused on welcoming international distributors to unveil the rebranding of the company’s most iconic line, Casa Magna, across all its versions: Colorado, Liga F, and Maduro. The new design is modern and fresh, yet it clearly conveys continuity through its conceptual clarity and, above all, respect for the brand's legacy.

items.title: PDR’s Small Batch Cabinet
items.summary: By pressing the 'I AM OF LEGAL AGE' button, I agree that I am of legal age for smoking and drinking in my country. Abe Flores, PDR Cigars, released at the Intertabac 2026 his new Small Batch Reserve, a novelty series featuring two distinct expressions, ready for international markets: first one with an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper, in a red band, and the other with a Broadleaf Maduro wrapper, in a blue band. Both use a Sumatra binder and a blend of Dominican and Broadleaf leaves in the filler. The new Small Batch Reserve comes in trendy formats—short, thick ring-gauge cigars (102 mm x 60 / 4x60)—and features a very classic cigar presentation: cabinet 25-count boxes with sliding lids.

In addition to Aladino’s regular lines and the award-winning, acclaimed blend of the Julio Eiroa’s 85th Anniversary, JRE Tobacco unveiled a bold new concept at Intertabac 2026: the Gorbustos. Developed by Justo Eiroa’s daughters, Vivian and Andrea, this concept embodies a fundamental truth about tobacco: the power of a fine cigar to forge bonds between the most diverse people.

items.title: Saint George in the 10th Anniversary
items.summary: By pressing the 'I AM OF LEGAL AGE' button, I agree that I am of legal age for smoking and drinking in my country. Slaying the dragon, like Saint George. Foundation Cigar Company was represented at Intertabac 2026 by George Frakes, the company's international markets manager. Foundation—the company founded by Nick Melillo ten years ago—has always maintained a striking and original design aesthetic, culminating in the 10th Anniversary Salomon, a cigar of 178 mmx 58 (7x58), which depicts Saint George driving his spear into the dragon. According to Frakes, "Saint George represents the tobacco industry overcoming the various challenges it faces, particularly in this years regarding regulations, but those are not the unique: it also represents the spirit of resilience, triumph, and dedication that has guided the company over the past decade ".
